card.name: Inside written-out math formulas
card.fires_on: Numbers, units or closing brackets inside an inline arithmetic formula, such as the creatinine clearance equation or a physics calculation, just before the next multiplier or bracket.

modes.label: Creatinine clearance formula
modes.description: A digit or bracket inside the Cockcroft-Gault equation, such as 72 or 0.85.

modes.label: Other dose or physics calculations
modes.description: A number or unit inside a typed-out calculation with multiplication.

modes.label: Units in worked physics
modes.description: A unit letter inside a worked physics calculation.

card.writes: It promotes the closing-and-reopening bracket pattern ')(' that joins factors in a formula.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of a typed-out math formula, where the next piece is usually another bracketed factor.
